subject.title: [Feature]: openclaw notify — admin-scoped push to connected UI sessions

question: Should OpenClaw add a core `openclaw notify` admin broadcast surface now, fold it into the broader WebUI notification architecture, or leave shell-originated alerts to plugin/external delivery paths?
rationale: The requested feature is absent, but it creates a new shell-facing admin capability that affects Gateway authorization, Control UI interruption policy, and security controls.

options.title: Design Core Notify Contract
options.body: Keep this issue as the canonical CLI/Gateway/Control UI feature and require an explicit admin event/RPC contract before implementation.

options.title: Fold Into WebUI Notifications
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/20237 own the UI architecture and supersede this issue only after it explicitly covers shell/admin broadcast.

options.title: Prefer External Delivery
options.body: Reject a core command and document supported plugin, Web Push, node, or channel workarounds if maintainers do not want shell-originated UI interruption.

recommendation.title: Design Core Notify Contract
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the canonical CLI/Gateway/Control UI feature and require an explicit admin event/RPC contract before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the best available routing candidate from current blame across the CLI, Gateway, and Control UI surfaces that would need a coordinated product/security contract.
